summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on experience designing real-time, high-throughput C/C++ systems on Linux. Architected distributed MPI work-distribution pipelines achieving up to 30x speedup and engineered memory-optimized data pipelines with concurrency for large-scale datasets. Skilled in object-oriented C++ design for scalable, maintainable, high-performance software.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Developed a custom image-stitching pipeline for high-resolution generation using bit manipulation and memory-managed batch averaging, achieving a PSNR of 65 compared to homography-based stitching baseline.
Designed a custom wavelet bank to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to improve output quality to a PSNR of 86.
Architected a full multi-stage processing pipeline integrating custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation into a single production-style system.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for a multi-modal MRI dataset with batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7; took over as team lead mid-project to restructure task distribution and deliver the full pipeline within a 6-week window.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Implemented and benchmarked four parallel work distribution strategies (static strip/block/cyclic, dynamic task queue) for rendering 5000x5000 pixel scenes using MPI in C/C++.
Achieved up to 30x speedup with static strip partitioning (55 processes); demonstrated dynamic task queue outperformed all static methods under unpredictable workloads.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Implemented distributed dendrite computations across MPI worker processes with synchronous soma updates on a SLURM-managed cluster.
Achieved up to 10.49x speedup with 12 slave processes; identified load imbalance effects showing up to 65% performance degradation under uneven work distribution.
